entities.name: PDU session status
entities.description: Indicates the PDU sessions that are associated with the access type that the message is sent over and are active within the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that includes the PDU session status IE when it needs to indicate active PDU sessions.

entities.name: PDU session active
entities.description: Condition where a PDU session is active within the network and associated with the access type of the message.

relations.description: Network includes the PDU session status IE in the message when needed.
PDU session status IE indicates PDU sessions that are active and associated with the access type.
